_note: The minted-id ledger. An id is MATCHED against this side, never computed on theirs (David, 2026-09-02) — so an id minted for the research library is not real until it is visible in this tree at a pushed head. Every entry here was minted by Sana with its region; the library's dossiers must arrive under these exact ids and regions, and validate:ingest enforces both. Rows leave this ledger when a catalog row exists under the id (the ledger is the reservation, the catalog is the destination). The 21 sailing/city ids below were minted 2026-09-02 (cowes-england overruling cowes-isle-of-wight per the UK constituent-country precedent; las-palmas-spain to 11C 'Caribbean & Atlantic' — David ratified both, 2026-09-04).

cowes-england.note: overrules cowes-isle-of-wight — UK ids use the constituent country (london-england, edinburgh-scotland); the island belongs in the name field

bodrum-turkey.note: the gulet coast sails the same sea as the Greek islands; Eastern Anatolia would be 04A if it ever comes

las-vegas-nevada.note: US ids use the state form, per the existing thirty

las-palmas-spain.note: the Canaries are Atlantic, not Mediterranean — 11C is 'Caribbean & Atlantic', and it puts the ARC's start and finish in one region. David ratified 2026-09-04.
